question: Why are there 102 approaches in September and 97 in October but only 5 in Nov-Dec 2026?
answer: The list includes asteroids discovered at or after their approach; most future close approaches are by objects not yet discovered, so future months look empty. It is an observation-bias artefact, not a real drop.
